mapper.sql: d.*, w.name AS warehouse_name, mt.code AS material_code, mt.name AS material_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ecom_owh_diff d LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = d.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_material mt ON mt.id = d.material_id WHERE d.source_type = #{sourceType} AND d.source_id = #{sourceId} ORDER BY d.id
